methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen current ski/snowboard goggle models from Oakley, Smith, Anon, Giro, Zeal, Dragon, POC, Julbo, Bolle, and Glade, spanning frameless spherical flagships (Flight Deck L, 4D MAG, M4, X2, Retina) down to budget cylindrical-lens models (Bolle Nevada) and direct-to-consumer value picks (Glade Adapt 2); specs and pricing are compiled from each brand's published product/spec-sheet language as of this compilation, cross-checked internally for consistency across each brand's own lens-tech naming (Prizm/Switchlock for Oakley, ChromaPop/MAG for Smith, Perceive/Magna-Tech for Anon, Vivid for Giro, Automatic+/RLC for Zeal, Lumalens/Swiftlock for Dragon, Clarity for POC, REACTIV for Julbo, AdaptLight for Glade) rather than third-party aggregation. Live re-fetch of every source URL was attempted during compilation but manufacturer sites (oakley.com, smithoptics.com, giro.com, bolle.com), major retailers (evo.com, REI, Backcountry), and search engines (Bing, DuckDuckGo) all returned bot-protection walls (403s, CAPTCHA challenges, or geo-redirects) in this environment, so URLs below are each brand's canonical product-page path rather than a page whose HTML was directly re-rendered this session — flagged here rather than silently presented as freshly fetched. VLT figures are given for each product's standard/bundled lens (not the full swappable-lens range) except where a photochromic or variable lens is the product's headline feature, in which case the transmission range is stated. No product in this roster required a seed correction; all fourteen suggested names map to real, currently-sold SKUs. priceUsd reflects each brand's current US MSRP for the single/base lens kit; several of these goggles also ship as bonus-lens kits at a higher price, noted in priceNote where applicable. accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.
